designVerdict: REJECTED - the 25 MHz crystal is on the W5500 module (see C134462).
notes: 25 MHz, SMD3225-4P, $0.068, 23k stock. The W5500 needs an external 25 MHz crystal; the ESP32-C6 module has its own on board.
CONFIRM the load capacitance against the W5500 datasheet before committing the matching capacitors - it was not checked here.

CONFIRMED AND MISMATCHED: the W5500 requires CL = 18 pF (datasheet section 5.5.3 p.60); this part is 20 pF. Either swap for an 18 pF-CL crystal with 27 pF load caps, or keep it with 30 pF caps and accept an uncharacterised negative-resistance margin.
RETIRED with the bare W5500. The CONFIRMED AND MISMATCHED note above - 20 pF against the W5500's required 18 pF CL - was a blocking open question and is now moot: the module brings its own crystal.
